exposure: Pathogenic variants within the regulatory domain of the PPP3CA gene
Type of pathogenic variants (e.g., truncating mutations)
Location of pathogenic variants (calmodulin-binding domain vs. regulatory domain)
cohort: The study included four previously unreported subjects carrying pathogenic variants within the regulatory domain of the PPP3CA gene, supplemented by subjects identified through a comprehensive literature review.
finding: The study revealed two distinct electro-clinical phenotypes of PPP3CA gene-related DEE, demonstrating that the type and location of pathogenic variants critically influence the severity and presentation, with regulatory domain variants often leading to more severe and drug-resistant epilepsy.
